exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Using the Verb 出す".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb 出す (~dasu) matches "Using the Verb 出す".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb 出す (~dasu).
